news.h: ‘I am a pretty cautious person’: My financial adviser wants me to invest $350,000 in a UAE data center. Is this risky?

news.h: My wife says we can’t afford to retire, yet she wants to take an $8,000 trip to Italy. We have $4 million. Do I keep working?

news.d: "Me preocupa la atención sanitaria, los cuidados a largo plazo, la inflación, un mercado bajista prolongado y vivir hasta los 95 años".
